method: Races with at least six editions of 3,000+ finishes spanning eight or more years (11 races, 146 editions): the gap between the 10th and 90th percentile finish, averaged over the first three and the last three such editions (Amsterdam 2012–2014 against 2023–2025; Berlin 2005–2007 against 2024–2026; Boston 2014–2018 against 2024–2026; Chicago 2006–2009 against 2024–2026; Copenhagen 2014–2016 against 2024–2026; Hamburg 2013–2015 against 2023–2025; Madrid 2013–2015 against 2024–2026; New York 2006–2009 against 2024–2026; Rotterdam 2013–2015 against 2022–2024; Warsaw 2015–2017 against 2024–2026; Washington 2008–2010 against 2016–2018).
